tweaks.name: Make sure Game Mode is ON
tweaks.why: Game Mode stops Windows Update from installing drivers or showing restart prompts while you play and gives the game scheduling priority. Old tweak guides turn it off; on current Windows it helps.

tweaks.name: Turn off Game DVR background recording
tweaks.why: Background recording keeps encoding your gameplay to memory the whole time you play. Turning it off removes that overhead. Game Bar itself stays installed (needed by X3D CPUs and controllers).
tweaks.breaks: Win+Alt+R recording and 'Record that' clips. Use NVIDIA/AMD/OBS recording instead.

tweaks.name: Optimizations for windowed games (flip model upgrade)
tweaks.why: Upgrades older DirectX 10/11 games running windowed or borderless to the modern flip presentation model: lower latency, and VRR/Auto HDR work there. Only this one token is changed, your Auto HDR/VRR choices are kept.
tweaks.source: Microsoft DirectX blog: Optimizations for windowed games (Windows 11)

tweaks.name: Disable mouse acceleration ('Enhance pointer precision')
tweaks.why: With acceleration on, cursor distance depends on how fast you move your hand, so flicks are inconsistent. Raw-input games ignore it, but menus and many games don't. Applies after sign-out.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling: ON
tweaks.why: Required for DLSS Frame Generation on RTX 40/50 cards. On older GPUs the effect varies by game, so benchmark before/after. Needs a reboot.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling: OFF
tweaks.why: Some older GPUs/drivers stutter with HAGS on. Turn it off only if benchmarks show better 1% lows without it. Breaks DLSS Frame Generation.

tweaks.name: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
tweaks.why: Only for PCs with flicker or stutter in borderless/windowed games or videos on multi-monitor setups (a known NVIDIA issue). Newer Windows builds may ignore this key; check the problem is actually gone.

tweaks.name: Disable fullscreen optimizations globally
tweaks.why: Forces the old exclusive-fullscreen behavior. On modern Windows, fullscreen optimizations already give flip-model latency; reported gains are anecdotal. Prefer the per-game compatibility checkbox if one game misbehaves.
tweaks.breaks: Alt-tab gets slower in exclusive fullscreen.
